verses.text: So copy God, as children he loves.
Live a life of love, just as Christ loved us. He gave himself up for us as an offering and sacrifice to God, like a sweet smell.
There must not even be a hint of sexual sin among you, or any kind of impure living, or greed. These are not right for God's holy people.
There must be no dirty talk, foolish talk, or crude jokes. They are out of place. Instead, give thanks to God.
You can be sure of this. No one who lives in sexual sin, or is impure, or greedy, will have any share in the Kingdom of Christ and of God. A greedy person is really worshipping an idol.
Do not let anyone fool you with empty words. Because of such things, God's anger comes on those who disobey him.
So do not join in with them.
Once you were darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light.
The fruit of the light is found in all that is good, right and true.
Find out what pleases the Lord.
Have nothing to do with the useless deeds of darkness. Instead, show them up for what they are.
It is shameful even to talk about what they do in secret.
But when the light shows things up as wrong, they become clear, because whatever makes things clear is light.
and everything made clear becomes light. That is why it is said, "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
So be very careful how you live. Do not live like foolish people, but like wise people.
Make the most of every chance, because the days are evil.
So do not be foolish. Understand what the Lord wants.
Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to wild living. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
Speak to one another with psalms, hymns and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music to the Lord from your heart.
Always give thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Put others first, out of respect for Christ.
Wives, put your husbands first, as you do the Lord.
The husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church. Christ is the Saviour of the church, which is his body.
As the church follows Christ, so wives should follow their husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her.
He did this to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word.
He wanted to bring the church to himself in all its beauty, with no stain or wrinkle or any other fault, but holy and without blame.
In the same way, husbands should love their wives as their own bodies. A man who loves his wife loves himself.
No one ever hated his own body. Instead, he feeds it and cares for it, just as Christ does for the church.
We are parts of his body, of his flesh and of his bones.
"That is why a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one body."
This is a deep secret, but I am talking about Christ and the church.
Still, each one of you must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
